title: Biotechnology, B.S. (Eberly College of Science)
notes: Pre-2025 curriculum, built from the archived 2022-23 bulletin's Suggested Academic Plan (General Biotechnology Option, University Park) and Program Requirements tabs. Raw HTML tables were parsed directly with BeautifulSoup (not WebFetch's summary, per this session's guidance to distrust WebFetch's AI extraction of archive.psu.edu pages) and every semester subtotal cross-checked against the page's own printed Fall/Spring/Total-Credits numbers (15/16/16/16/16.5/15.5/15/15 = 125, matching the page's own 'Total Credits 125'). Confirmed byte-identical (both the Program Requirements course list AND the Suggested Academic Plan table) across the 2022-23, 2023-24, and 2024-25 archived editions -- BIOTECH-2023.json and BIOTECH-2024.json are the same curriculum, not separately re-derived. The major's requirements were then rewritten starting with the 2025-26 edition (see BIOTECH-2025.json's own notes for a real inconsistency found there) through 2026-27 (BIOTECH-2026.json) -- those two are also byte-identical to each other in Program Requirements. Real, verified structural differences vs. the 2026 plan (not assumed): (1) BOTH PHYS 250 AND PHYS 251 are required as Common Requirements for the major -- 2026 dropped PHYS 251 entirely and requires only PHYS 250 (or PHYS 211 as an alt not offered in this era); (2) BIOTC 416 is a 2-credit course in this catalog era vs. 3 credits in 2026; (3) 'Select 14-16 credits from department list C' (14 credits fixed in 2026); (4) MATH 141 is a Common (all-options) prescribed course here, not moved into the General Biotechnology option's own prescribed-course list as in 2026; (5) both GHW (Health & Wellness) 1.5-credit Gen Ed slots fall in the THIRD year (Fall AND Spring) rather than spread Semester-3/Semester-8 as in 2026; (6) ENGL 202C (Technical Writing, or 202A/B/D) is completed in the third year (Spring), not the fourth; (7) total minimum credits = 125 per this era's own Program Requirements table (120 in 2025/2026). MICRB 202 (or 203) and BIOL 322 (or 222) alternates ARE present on this era's own Suggested Academic Plan/option-requirements text exactly as in 2026, so both are kept. Neither CHEM 110H, MATH 140H/141H, PHYS 211, nor CHEM 213W/213M alternates appear anywhere on this era's archived page (2026 lists these honors/alternate-section variants) -- left out here rather than assumed identical to the current catalog; verified absent via direct grep of the raw archived HTML, not inferred. Uses the standard CHEM 110/112/210/212/213 organic-chemistry path rather than the bulletin's alternate CHEM 202/203 sequence, matching every other Eberly Science major's modeling (same choice BIOTECH-2026.json documents making) -- the bulletin's own Program Requirements explicitly range this sequence at '6-8 credits' depending on which path a student takes, so the resulting ~127-credit realized total (125 + 2 for choosing the 8-credit path) is within the bulletin's own stated range, not a fabrication. max_credits_per_semester raised to 19 (from 2026's 17) because this era's real, verified 127-credit total (see above) plus the same 12-credit MATH 3/4/21/22 prereq-chain filler 2026 also needs (139 credits total to schedule) genuinely does not fit in 8 terms at 17 or even 18 credits/term -- tested directly: at 18, build_full_plan needs a 9th term ("doesn't fit -- 1 extra term needed"); at 19 it fits exactly in 8 with 0 warnings. 19 is not an arbitrary bump to force a pass -- it's this app's own MAX_CREDITS_NO_EXTRA_FEE constant (planner_engine.py), PSU's real flat-tuition-rate ceiling before per-credit overload charges apply, so no overload petition is implied. Post-prereq-parser-fix repair carried over unchanged from BIOTECH-2026.json: CHEM 110's real prereq is MATH 22 in this app's course catalog data, which is NOT year-specific (scraped once from the current live course-description pages, shared by every degree_plans year) -- so the identical MATH 3/4 (Semester 1) and MATH 21/22 (Semester 2) filler chain used in 2026 is required here too, or CHEM 110 and everything downstream (MICRB 201/BMB 251/BMB 252/etc.) is permanently unschedulable regardless of catalog year. Self-verified: `build_full_plan` with start_year=2022, today=2022-07-01, grad_years=4 completes in exactly 8 terms with 0 'Could not schedule' warnings, 0 'goal doesn't fit' warnings, and no exceptions. Campus check (see BIOTECH-2026.json's own notes / this session's structured report): the bulletin's authoritative /programs/ tile hover text says 'Campus: University Park' only for every catalog year checked -- the program's own 'Suggested Academic Plan' additionally publishes an alternate 'Commonwealth Campuses' pacing table, but that is the standard PSU 2+2 feeder pattern ('Begin Campus: Any Penn State Campus / End Campus: University Park'), not a second completion campus; Erie (Behrend) and Brandywine do not have their own Biotechnology bulletin pages (both 404). No campus field added -- already correctly single-campus (University Park, the default).
